primary.title: Exporter Dollar Sales Bolster Malaysian Ringgit, Analysts Say
primary.summary: Malaysian exporters are likely increasing conversions of their foreign-currency earnings into the ringgit, which stands to boost the local exchange rate through the rest of the year, analysts say.
